name: Linfield
notes: Members-owned; UEFA fine 2025 for racist/discriminatory supporter behaviour and IFA fine 2023 for sectarian chanting and a racist comment.

name: Liverpool
notes: Fenway Sports Group majority, 38% sold to 1892 Holdings 2026; signed and withdrew from 2021 Super League; Turkish Airlines (part state-owned) shirt deal announced from 2027; no fan sanctions 2021-26 found.

name: Lorient
notes: Chairman Loic Fery; Bill Foley's Black Knight (Bournemouth network) holds a large stake; no fan sanctions found.

name: Los Angeles Football Club
notes: Local investor group; MLS fined club $100k and suspended 3252 privileges over flares (Dec 2023); fans involved in a March 2025 brawl at San Diego; head coach post vacant since 27 Sept 2026.

name: Loudoun United FC
notes: Attain Sports majority since 2023, D.C. United minority; reported racist chants by fans in May 2021 (outcome not found, over 5 years ago).

name: Louisville City FC
notes: Local owner Soccer Holdings (also owns NWSL Racing Louisville); created by moving Orlando City's USL franchise; no sanctions found; interim coach since March 2026.

name: Luton Town
notes: Owned by local supporter-businessmen consortium that rescued club in 2008; Trust board seat and identity veto; FA fine 2023 for homophobic chanting.

name: Lyon
notes: Michele Kang's Olympe Bidco took 87.8% in June 2026 (Kang also owns Washington Spirit, London City Lionesses); DNCG relegation ruling 2025 and 2026 wage cap; homophobic-chant cases 2024; Payet bottle incident Nov 2021; Emirates main sponsor, Winamax on back.

name: Mainz 05
notes: Member-run e.V. with no outside investor; no sanctions found; a hooligan-leaning group appeared in 2024 without recorded incidents.

name: Manchester City
notes: Owned by Abu Dhabi United Group (Sheikh Mansour, UAE vice-president) via City Football Group; Etihad (state airline) shirt/stadium; UEFA 2020 case (fine after CAS) and Premier League commission guilty finding on 114 charges (Sept 2026, appeal expected); left 2021 Super League within two days.

name: Manchester United
notes: Glazer family control since 2005 leveraged buyout (debt still on club); INEOS ~29% (also owns Nice); left 2021 Super League within two days; no fan sanctions 2021-26 found.

name: Mansfield Town
notes: Local owner John Radford since 2010; no sanctions found.

name: Marseille
notes: Frank McCourt (US) owns 95%; UEFA 2026 EUR 10m settlement for deficit/squad-cost breaches; repeated UEFA/LFP sanctions for fan violence 2022-26 (Lyon bus stoning 2023); homophobic-chant case 2026; Unibet front, Cote d'Ivoire tourism sleeve.

name: Marítimo
notes: Club (members) controls the SAD; 2025 40% SAD sale to Revee voided over organised-crime reports; bwin front-of-shirt from 2026-27.

name: Miami FC
notes: Owner Riccardo Silva (Silva International, Miami); no sanctions found.

name: Middlesbrough
notes: Local owner Steve Gibson since 1994; Midnite (betting) front-of-shirt 2026-27; no sanctions found.

name: Millwall
notes: Berylson family (US) since 2007; repeated FA fines for discriminatory chanting (sectarian 2023, homophobic 2025, disability 2026, pending charges 2026, racist 2019); no recent violence sanction found.

name: Milton Keynes Dons
notes: Created 2004 by relocating Wimbledon FC; Kuwaiti consortium led by Fahad Al Ghanim since 2024 (family also tied to Kuwait SC); Visit Kuwait (state tourism) sleeve.

name: Minnesota United FC
notes: Local ownership group led by Bill McGuire; privately built stadium; no sanctions found.

name: Monaco
notes: Rybolovlev's Monaco Sport Investment 66.7%, Grimaldi family 33.3% (Cercle Brugge in same ownership); VBET shorts sponsor, DR Congo tourism sleeve.

name: Monterey Bay FC
notes: Regional businessman Ray Beshoff; formed with the franchise rights of defunct Fresno FC; no sanctions found.

name: Monza
notes: US fund Beckett Layne Ventures owns 100% (2025-26); Monza ultras banned after 2024 clash with Napoli fans; DAZN Bet shirt sponsor.

name: Málaga
notes: Majority owner Sheikh Abdullah Al Thani removed from management; court-appointed administrator since 2020; April 2026 arrest warrant for the owner over misappropriation.

name: Nacional
notes: Club-controlled SAD, president Rui Alves since 1994; ACA Football Partners deal cancelled; partly funded by regional public support.

name: Napoli
notes: Aurelio De Laurentiis (Filmauro) since 2004 re-founding, also owns Bari; owner on trial for false accounting and under investigation (Bari); repeated fan violence 2023-25 (A1 brawl, Eintracht clashes, Cagliari fine).

name: Nashville SC
notes: Local owner John Ingram; no club or fan sanctions found (one player banned 2024 for a discriminatory remark).

name: New England Revolution
notes: Kraft Group (NFL Patriots owners); plays in NFL stadium in Foxborough, soccer stadium in Everett planned; no sanctions found.

name: New Mexico United
notes: Local majority owner Peter Trevisani; plays in a baseball park; no sanctions found.

name: New York City Football Club
notes: City Football Group (controlled by Abu Dhabi United Group) holds 80%; Etihad (Abu Dhabi state airline) shirt; Oct 2024 spectator homophobic slur confirmed by MLS, no sanction.

name: Newcastle United
notes: Saudi Public Investment Fund owns 85% since 2021 (PIF also controls four Saudi clubs); Noon (PIF co-owned) sleeve; no fan sanctions 2021-26 found.

name: Newport County
notes: Huw Jenkins 52% since 2024; Supporters' Trust 27% with two board seats (ran the club 2015-24); fans re-formed the club after 1989 liquidation.

name: Nice
notes: INEOS-owned (Manchester United flagship); LFP closures for racist banners and homophobic chants (2019, 2025); organised violence: Koln 2022, ultras assaulted own players Nov 2025, 2026 pitch invasion led to closed-door matches; VBET shorts.

name: Northampton Town
notes: Chinese firm 5uSport bought 60% in 2017, Kelvin Thomas executive chairman; no sanctions found.

name: Norwich City
notes: Mark Attanasio (Milwaukee Brewers owner) ~85% since 2024; FA fine Jan 2024 for disability-related chanting.

name: Nottingham Forest
notes: Evangelos Marinakis since 2017 (also owns Olympiacos, Rio Ave; shares in blind trust 2026); 2024 PSR points deduction; May 2022 pitch invasion (fan headbutted Billy Sharp); Bally's Intralot sleeve.

name: Notts County
notes: Danish brothers Christoffer and Alexander Reedtz since 2019; no sanctions found.

name: Oakland Roots SC
notes: Founders with community investors; 1% of payroll and ticket revenue pledged to Common Goal; sister club Oakland Soul; no sanctions found.

name: Oldham Athletic
notes: Local businessman Frank Rothwell since 2022 (bought from Abdallah Lemsagam after fan protests); no sanctions found.

name: Orange County SC
notes: Owner James Keston since 2016; no sanctions found.

name: Orlando City
notes: Wilf family (NFL Vikings) since 2021, also own Orlando Pride; club began as the relocated Austin Aztex USL franchise (2010); supporter-group bans 2014 and 2018 are over 5 years old.

name: Osasuna
notes: Member-owned; 50+ sanctions for intolerant chants from the Grada Sur, abuse chants at Vinicius investigated (2024, 2026); State Commission proposed two-month closure and EUR 200k (June 2026); Feb 2026 police charges and Indar Gorri arrests.

name: Oxford United
notes: Erick Thohir (Indonesian businessman/politician) sole controlling owner; no sanctions found.

name: PSV Eindhoven
notes: Shares held by Stichting PSV Football with one share for the members' club (no private owner); UEFA fine and stand closure after a fan punched Sevilla goalkeeper (Feb 2023).

name: Paris FC
notes: Arnault family (Agache) 52.4%, Ferracci 29.8%, Red Bull 10.6%; Bahrain Victorious (Kingdom of Bahrain brand) main sponsor, Bwin shorts.

name: Paris Saint-Germain
notes: Qatar Sports Investments 85.9%, Arctos Partners 12.5%; Qatar Airways shirt; UEFA 2022 FFP settlement fine; repeated LFP sanctions for homophobic chants from Auteuil (2023, 2024, 2025).

name: Parma
notes: Krause Group (Kyle Krause, US) since 2020; 2015 bankruptcy and re-foundation; head coach post vacant since 27 Sept 2026.

name: Peterborough United
notes: Darragh MacAnthony (Irish) 75%, Kelgary Sports 20%; no sanctions found.

name: Philadelphia Union
notes: Jay Sugarman (Keystone); MLS suspended sporting director Ernst Tanner to June 2026 for racist, sexist and anti-gay remarks (he denies them); no fan sanctions found.

name: Phoenix Rising FC
notes: Principal owner Pablo Prichard; player suspended in 2020 for alleged homophobic slur (over 5 years ago).

name: Pittsburgh Riverhounds
notes: Local owner Tuffy Shallenberger, bought club out of Chapter 11 (2014); 2025 slur allegation against a player ruled unsubstantiated.

name: Plymouth Argyle
notes: Owner/chairman Simon Hallett, lifelong fan; no sanctions found.

name: Port Vale
notes: Local owners Carol and Kevin Shanahan since 2019; no sanctions found.

name: Portland Timbers
notes: Merritt Paulson owner (sold Thorns 2024 after the 2021-22 abuse-scandal handling); no MLS fan sanctions 2021-26 found.

name: Porto
notes: Members control the SAD, Villas-Boas elected 2024; Super Dragoes members assaulted members at Nov 2023 assembly (leader convicted 2025); UEFA FFP settlement; Betano shirt.

name: Portsmouth
notes: Michael Eisner's Tornante since 2017, bought from the Pompey Supporters' Trust (fan-owned 2013-17); no sanctions found.

name: Preston North End
notes: Hemmings family (Wordon Ltd); FA fine 2024 for homophobic chanting at two matches; club backed a player found guilty of racial abuse (2025).

name: Queens Park Rangers
notes: Consortium of Ruben Gnanalingam, Richard Reilly and Lakshmi Mittal; 2013-14 FFP breach settled 2018 (GBP 42m); MrQ (bingo/casino) shirt sponsor.

name: RB Leipzig
notes: Red Bull GmbH owns 99%; created 2009 via SSV Markranstadt's licence; closed membership meets 50+1 formally.

name: Racing Santander
notes: Controlled by Santander-born businessman Sebastian Ceria (Pitma); fans led 2014-15 campaign and rescue after Ali Syed-era crisis.

name: Rangers
notes: Cavenagh/49ers Enterprises consortium 51% since 2025 (Leeds is network flagship), Club 1872 fan shareholders minority; repeated UEFA discrimination sanctions incl. 2025; fan disorder Manchester Jan 2025, Bilbao 2025, Ibrox 2026; 2012 liquidation and fourth-tier restart.
